{{Top|leg}}
'''Battlegroup Turak''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force assigned to [[Turak IV]], and participated in the [[Battle of Turak IV]]. Under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maltaz]], elements of Battlegroup Turak included the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]], and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] [[Squad 5-Aurek]] and [[Squad 5-Cresh]].
